name: Sky Ride
address: 3300 J. David Jones Parkway, Suite B

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM).
findings.citation_text:
2-102.12(A) Certified Food Protection Manager. (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

The PIC for this facility has not completed and acquired a CFPM certificate. A hand out was given with current local options for the course/test. They are instructed to acquire a CFPM prior tot he next routine inspection.

findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting.
findings.citation_text:
2-103.11(P) Person In Charge. The PERSON IN CHARGE shall ensure that: (P) FOOD EMPLOYEES and CONDITIONAL EMPLOYEES are informed in a verifiable manner of their responsibility to report in accordance with LAW, to the PERSON IN CHARGE, information about their health and activities as they relate to diseases that are transmissible through FOOD, as specified under 2-201.11(A).

On arrival the PIC could not provide verification of employees being notified of their responsibility to report. The PIC called the food manager and they could not direct them to them either. Fresh copies of the SCDPH Reporting Agreements were given to be signed prior to the follow-up scheduled for 10/27/25.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment:
(REPEAT x2)6-301.12 Hand Drying Provision. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels.

The hand sink next to the three part sink is without paper towels at the start of this inspection. Paper towels were supplied to correct.

findings.title: Food separated and protected.
findings.citation_text:
3-302.11(A)(2) Packaged and Unpackaged Food - Separation, Packaging, and Segregation. (A) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by: (2) Except when combined as ingredients, separating types of raw animal FOODS from each other such as beef, FISH, lamb, pork, and POULTRY during storage, preparation, holding, and display by: (a) Using separate EQUIPMENT for each type, or (b) Arranging each type of FOOD in EQUIPMENT so that cross contamination of one type with another is prevented, and (c) Preparing each type of FOOD at different times or in separate areas.

A package of raw sausage is observed over containers of Ready-To-Eat sauces in a standing cooler. The PIC was shown and educated. The package was moved to the bottom cooler to correct.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text:
4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

The deflector shield in the ice machine is observed with slime/mold growth. The PIC was shown and cleaned the location to correct.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
6-301.12: Each HANDWASHING SINK shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; (C) A heated-air hand drying device; (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures. 

Both the back and the front hand sinks are without paper towels during this inspection. paper towels were suplied during this inspection to correct.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

Multiple nozzles on the soda fountain machine are observed soiled. PIC indicated that they are cleaned weekly. This does not appear to be sufficient. Clean often enough to maintain free of soilage. The nozzles were cleaned/sanitized during the inspection to correct.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-602.11: (A) FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall be cleaned before each use, each time there is a change in work, between uses of raw FOODS to RTE FOODS, before using FOOD TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE, and when contamination has occurred. (C) Cleaned at least every 4 hours. 

Multiple utensils are observed stored above the grill and still being soiled. The ice scoop is also observed soiled. The PIC was shown and moved the items back to dish for re-cleaning. Ensure all food contact items are thoroughly cleaned prior to storage and use.
